M110-C01-S01.title: The Golden Chaise
M110-C01-S01.narration: After six hours of coronation ceremonies, you return to your chambers. Lucien offers grapes, Kael loosens your cloak, Cassian warms your tea, and Sylas welcomes you with his harp.
options: Invite Cassian to sit beside you

M110-C01-S02.title: Your First Invitation
M110-C01-S02.narration: The man you choose steps forward. The others each find their own way to hide their jealousy.

M110-C01-S03.title: Midnight Jade Tokens
M110-C01-S03.narration: The chamberlain presents twelve engraved jade tokens. Tonight, invite one companion, two, or everyone for music.

M110-C01-S04.title: The Black Rose Warning
M110-C01-S04.narration: The candles flicker out. A black rose lands on your pillow with a warning: before the seventh sunrise, someone close to you will cause your death.

M110-C02-S01.title: Breakfast at Your Door
M110-C02-S01.narration: Six men compete to deliver breakfast. Lucien carries strawberries, Theo brings pastries, Rowan holds massage oil, and Finn arrives with his lute.

M110-C02-S02.title: The Eastern Palace
M110-C02-S02.narration: The chamberlain announces that the first Noble Consort will receive the Eastern Palace. Cassian offers to manage the household; Lucien wants your public affection.

M110-C02-S03.title: Gifts in Daylight
M110-C02-S03.narration: Royal artisans present a brooch, a cloak, and an amber ring. Your companions wait for your decision.
options: Give a gift to someone overlooked
Keep the gifts in the treasury

M110-C02-S04.title: Whispers in the Corridor
M110-C02-S04.narration: Out of sight, you hear a noble confront Lucien: he took their money, so why has he fallen for the Empress? Lucien says nothing.

M110-C03-S01.title: Names on a Silver Tray
M110-C03-S01.narration: At midnight, the jade tokens glow gold. Darian’s flashes first. Every man waits for your choice.
options: Visit the hot springs with Kael
Walk in the garden with Sylas
Drink and play chess with Darian

M110-C03-S02.title: A Private Moment
M110-C03-S02.narration: In your chambers, your chosen companion asks whether you would like to hold hands, embrace, or be alone. You may always decline.

M110-C03-S03.title: Morning Jealousy
M110-C03-S03.narration: When your companion leaves your chambers, the others struggle to hide their jealousy. Finn turns it into a song.
options: Promise another round of fair invitations

M110-C03-S04.title: The First Empress in the Mirror
M110-C03-S04.narration: The ancient Empress Seraphine appears in the mirror. The crown is a chain, not a blessing. She leaves you one name: Isaac.

M110-C04-S01.title: An Empty Garden
M110-C04-S01.narration: Sylas is late for your moonlit walk. Noel waits beside the fountain with white roses.

M110-C04-S02.title: The Hidden Invitation
M110-C04-S02.narration: You find the torn invitation. Its scent leads to Noel’s greenhouse. He admits he wanted one afternoon to himself with you.
options: Ask him to apologize to Sylas

M110-C04-S03.title: The Red-Haired Consort
M110-C04-S03.narration: Lucien brings grapes and a self-deprecating smile. If you have overlooked him for three major events, he admits how much he misses you; otherwise, he has simply come to visit.
options: Explain how busy you have been

M110-C04-S04.title: The Burning Moon Mark
M110-C04-S04.narration: Sylas collapses beside the fountain, unable to cast a spell. The former Emperor’s ring lies on the ground.
options: Help Sylas back to the palace

M110-C05-S01.title: Twenty Men Take the Stage
M110-C05-S01.narration: The banquet begins. Lucien offers grapes, Rafael dances, Finn plays, Kael guards the doors, and Cassian pours tea.
options: Invite three men to perform together

M110-C05-S02.title: Jealousy on Stage
M110-C05-S02.narration: Finn improvises a song about everyone’s feelings. Blushing, the men compete to rewrite his lyrics.
options: Listen to Sylas play the harp

M110-C05-S03.title: The Switched Wine
M110-C05-S03.narration: Someone switches the wineglass. Elias cries out, and Finn collapses. Kael seals the doors while Lucien falls silent.

M110-C05-S04.title: The Sealed Melody
M110-C05-S04.narration: Finn awakens and sings a fractured melody that reveals the former Emperor’s final moments: the crown consumed him.

M110-C06-S01.title: The Hidden Inscription
M110-C06-S01.narration: You take four companions into a secret chamber. Inside are a four-hundred-year-old portrait of Seraphine and runes naming twenty consorts.

M110-C06-S02.title: A Vow from Four Centuries Ago
M110-C06-S02.narration: Seraphine wove the crown from freely given vows. The priest Isaac rewrote it into a trap that steals lives.

M110-C06-S03.title: Secrets at Court
M110-C06-S03.narration: Twelve core companions each hold a clue. You choose whom to trust; investigation can recover clues from those you do not confide in.

M110-C06-S04.title: The Empress’s Declaration
M110-C06-S04.narration: At a court gathering, you insist that every man must be free to leave. Kael is the first to choose to protect you.

M110-C07-S01.title: Crimson Lightning
M110-C07-S01.narration: On the seventh night, the curse inside the crown tears through the dome. Your companions shield you.
options: Ask Elias to raise a barrier

M110-C07-S02.title: Kael’s Death
M110-C07-S02.narration: A magical spear flies toward you. Kael takes the blow and stops breathing in your arms. The crown steals his soul.
options: Fight through the pain and give orders

M110-C07-S03.title: Loyalty in Free Fall
M110-C07-S03.narration: Lucien breaks down, Cassian organizes the evacuation, and Darian’s rage sets the hall ablaze.
options: Ask Cassian to steady the court
Ask Darian to stop the flames

M110-C07-S04.title: The Chamberlain Unmasked
M110-C07-S04.narration: Valerian exposes the chamberlain as Isaac’s host. Isaac offers a bargain: the crown in exchange for Kael’s soul.

M110-C08-S01.title: A Freely Given Heart
M110-C08-S01.narration: You discover that the crown cannot command a freely given heart. Your companions volunteer their magic.

M110-C08-S02.title: Four Ways to Break a Crown
M110-C08-S02.narration: Your chosen ritual unfolds: shared vows, dragonfire, rewritten runes in the soul labyrinth, or a seal forged from Isaac’s true name.

M110-C08-S03.title: Kael Returns
M110-C08-S03.narration: As the golden light fades, Kael appears in the doorway. His wounds are gone, but he remembers you calling his name.

M110-C08-S04.title: Who May Command Love?
M110-C08-S04.narration: As Isaac fades, Seraphine thanks you for choosing a different path. You decide how the palace will change.
options: Hold a memorial and celebration first
Search for remnants of the curse

M110-C09-S01.title: The Court Reform Council
M110-C09-S01.narration: Three days after Kael’s return, laughter and arguments fill the palace again. Cassian discusses reform; Lucien is bored with the meeting.

M110-C09-S02.title: Twenty Performances
M110-C09-S02.narration: Everyone shares a talent: dance, music, flowers, desserts, massage, painting, prophecy, dragonfire, and more.

M110-C09-S03.title: The First Imperial Consort
M110-C09-S03.narration: You may appoint a principal consort or leave the position open. Those not chosen express their feelings without pressuring you to change your mind.
options: Grant freedom to come and go

M110-C09-S04.title: Who Gets Midnight?
M110-C09-S04.narration: Lucien asks who will see you first tomorrow. Kael laughs, and Finn launches into another song about courtly jealousy.
options: Spend time alone with one man

M110-C10-S01.title: The New Moon Celebration
M110-C10-S01.narration: One month later, the empire celebrates restored peace. Twenty men prepare a celebration just for you.

M110-C10-S02.title: Your Final Decree
M110-C10-S02.narration: You choose the future of the court: one special love, multiple partners, equal standing, or the empire first.

M110-C10-S03.title: The Second Crown
M110-C10-S03.narration: If you have earned the hidden clues, Seraphine reveals a second crown beneath the sea. Otherwise, the celebration remains peaceful.
options: Enjoy your life at court for now

M110-C10-S04.title: A Golden Morning
M110-C10-S04.narration: Lucien steals strawberries, Cassian reads the schedule, and Kael tries to keep everyone from waking you. You open your eyes. Another day at court begins.

CASSIAN.appearanceEn: Blond hair, green eyes; gentle and composed, with a gift for etiquette, breakfast, and keeping the household together.
CASSIAN.desireEn: He wants his place in your life to be acknowledged.
CASSIAN.secretEn: He holds the former Emperor’s regency decree.

LUCIEN.appearanceEn: Red hair and amber eyes; openly flirtatious, fond of grapes and playful affection.
LUCIEN.desireEn: He wants to be chosen openly.
LUCIEN.secretEn: He once accepted payment to gather information for the nobles.

KAEL.appearanceEn: Short silver-black hair; strong, quiet, protective, and unexpectedly gentle.
KAEL.desireEn: He wants you to see his tenderness.
KAEL.secretEn: He refused an order to assassinate you.

SYLAS.appearanceEn: Silver hair and violet eyes; poetic, romantic, and skilled in elven magic.
SYLAS.desireEn: He wants to be remembered and understood.
SYLAS.secretEn: He bears a lunar contract rune.

DARIAN.appearanceEn: Black hair and red eyes; proud and dangerous, with no patience for flattery.
DARIAN.desireEn: He wants to be desired as an equal.
DARIAN.secretEn: His blood oath is connected to the crown.

ELIAS.appearanceEn: Platinum-blond hair; restrained, sincere, and gifted in sacred healing.
ELIAS.desireEn: He wants faith and love to coexist.
ELIAS.secretEn: He knows a prophecy of death on the seventh night.

RAFAEL.appearanceEn: Brown curls; warm, lively, and an exceptional dancer.
RAFAEL.desireEn: He wants to be seen as a person, not a performance.
RAFAEL.secretEn: He once informed for a resistance movement.

ALISTAIR.appearanceEn: Black hair and gold-rimmed glasses; witty, steady, and an accomplished chess player.
ALISTAIR.desireEn: He longs for a meeting of minds.
ALISTAIR.secretEn: He is investigating the former Emperor’s death.

NOEL.appearanceEn: Chestnut hair; sensitive and gentle, with a talent for flowers and baking.
NOEL.desireEn: He seeks security and steady companionship.

MALIK.appearanceEn: Dark skin; mature, elegant, and knowledgeable about fragrant oils and hot-spring rituals.
MALIK.desireEn: He wants respect within the relationship.
MALIK.secretEn: He has a claim to a foreign throne.

FINN.appearanceEn: Golden-brown hair; lively and funny, with magic woven into his songs.
FINN.desireEn: He wants to be heard seriously.
FINN.secretEn: His songs preserve memories of the former reign.

VALERIAN.appearanceEn: Black hair streaked with silver; mature, calm, and an expert investigator.
VALERIAN.desireEn: He wants to be trusted rather than feared.
VALERIAN.secretEn: He knows the truth about your bloodline.

THEO.appearanceEn: Light brown hair; thoughtful, warm, and devoted to his craft.
THEO.desireEn: He wants his handmade gifts to be appreciated.
THEO.secretEn: He saw suspicious orders arrive at the kitchens.

ROWAN.appearanceEn: Brown hair; steady, patient, and attentive.
ROWAN.desireEn: He wants his companionship to be valued.
ROWAN.secretEn: He discovered a suspicious fragrant oil.

EVREN.appearanceEn: Deep purple hair and a mysterious manner.
EVREN.desireEn: He wants his visions to be trusted.
EVREN.secretEn: He has seen two crowns in the stars.

NICO.appearanceEn: Slightly curled black hair and a playful wit.
NICO.desireEn: He wants to be truly seen.
NICO.secretEn: He painted the chamberlain with two shadows.

ORION.appearanceEn: Dark brown hair; rugged in appearance, gentle with his creatures.
ORION.desireEn: He wants his gentleness to be recognized.
ORION.secretEn: His creatures can sense the crown’s curse.

JASPER.appearanceEn: Light chestnut hair and a bright, friendly manner.

CASSIEL.desireEn: He wants to feel safe showing his softer side.
CASSIEL.secretEn: He can freeze fragments of the curse.

ADRIEN.appearanceEn: Ink-black hair and an elegant manner.
ADRIEN.desireEn: He cherishes personal rituals shared with you.
ADRIEN.secretEn: He can recognize Isaac’s signature scent.
